role: CI gate (App Review 5.1.3(ii)): no Swift file that names CKRecord may write a health scalar to a record field, legacy settings fields may only be set to nil, the named payload builders must seal through CloudPayloadCodec.sealForUpload, sealForUpload must fail closed, and the payload readers must decode before decompressing.
toplevel: cd to repo root. No Emuqu/Sources/Storage/CloudKit*.swift -> exit 2. Python over every Swift file under Emuqu and the watch app that contains `CKRecord` (none -> 2): resolves `let name = "literal"` constants (a name maps to every value it has); a write is `<x>record[<literal or constant>] = value` or `.setValue/.setObject(value, forKey: <literal or constant>)`; health-field key -> error; settingsJSON/deviceName key with a value other than nil -> error. Writer loop (compressedPayload, compressedPoints, sealedLocalSettings, scrubStoredRecord) under Emuqu/Sources/Storage: not found -> exit 2; awk body to first 4-space `}`; body without `CloudPayloadCodec.sealForUpload(` -> error. Seal check: awk body of `func sealForUpload` in CloudPayloadCodec.swift; empty -> exit 2; body without `throw CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable` -> error; body with `return payload` -> error. Reader loop (decodePoints, decodeSessionAsset): not found -> exit 2; body without DataCompression.decompress -> exit 2; body without CloudPayloadCodec.decode -> error. bad>0 -> exit 1; else clean.
